observations.quarter: Whole isolated hollow tyre is framed; continuous shoulder silhouette and estimated groove families readable. No old uniform-grid lip serrations established in this view.
observations.rear-tread: Two sinuous main channels, oblique shoulder incisions and sparse central links readable. Repetition remains an authored estimate, not an identified commercial mould.
observations.tread-detail: Grain and rounded groove lips readable. Small triangular tongues/shelves occur where incisions meet main channels; the max-union of unequal and tapered authored depth fields explains this class of junction geometry. Lighting emphasizes the faces. This does not establish the geometry of the real tyre mould, and not every image pixel has been matched to a particular triangle. Junction shape is retained as an explicit artistic/photographic uncertainty, not dismissed as reflection or accepted as OEM.
observations.bead-opening: Native macro deliberately crops outer envelope. Hollow inner profile, estimated bead lip and uninterrupted inner annulus readable. Rim fit, bead seating, inner construction and loaded shape unverified.
